title: Hertz contact of a hemisphere on a rigid flat
prompt:
Contact analysis. hemisphere.step is a solid steel hemisphere of radius 50 mm (millimetres): its flat face is the plane z = 50 mm and its curved surface touches the plane z = 0 at the origin. Material: linear isotropic elastic, E = 210000 MPa, Poisson ratio 0.3; small strains. A total force of 10000 N acts on the flat face as a uniform pressure, pushing the hemisphere down (-z) onto a rigid, frictionless, flat foundation occupying z <= 0. Nothing else restrains the hemisphere. Compute the radius of the circular contact area and the largest contact pressure.

Outputs:
- contact_radius_mm [mm]: radius of the contact area
- max_contact_pressure_MPa [MPa]: largest contact pressure

Submit results.json containing exactly an outputs object with these numeric keys.

title: Large deflection of a cantilever under a dead tip load
prompt:
Large-deflection analysis. bar.step is a straight solid bar in millimetres: x from 0 to 10000 mm (length), y from -150 to 150 mm (width), z from -51.305 to 51.305 mm (depth 102.61 mm). Material: St Venant-Kirchhoff hyperelastic (second Piola-Kirchhoff stress linear in the Green-Lagrange strain), E = 100 MPa, Poisson ratio 0. The face x = 0 is fully clamped. A total force of 269.35 N acts on the face x = 10000 mm as a uniform traction per unit of undeformed area, always pointing in -z (a dead load that does not rotate with the bar). Displacements are large: equilibrium must be found in the deformed configuration. Report, for the centroid of the loaded end face, the vertical deflection (downward, positive) and the horizontal displacement towards the support (positive).

Outputs:
- tip_vertical_deflection_mm [mm]: downward displacement of the end-face centroid
- tip_horizontal_displacement_mm [mm]: displacement of the end-face centroid towards the clamped end

Submit results.json containing exactly an outputs object with these numeric keys.
